capsule.admissionAuthority: trusted admitCapsule(review:"off") — same authority as ordering-check and run-boundary rechecks; no owner Gate-2 receipt minted

revision.reason: Prior OSS-H02 admission failed: on the broad TPC-H Q1/Q6/Q12 mix the control ladder's separation sat below the host-noise band. USER DECISION: one authoring round to a narrower challenge with real control headroom.
revision.challenge: single-operator physical-filter microbenchmark: one always-true string-kernel predicate (train lower(), validation upper()) over fixed SF1 lineitem behind an OFFSET 0 pushdown barrier; the filter operator carries ~47% of baseline runtime (EXPLAIN ANALYZE: 210ms of 448ms)
evaluatorHardening: trusted-parent CLOCK_MONOTONIC wall timing around the full process; score is reciprocal median of the fastest 5 of 7 samples (host contention only adds time; trimming rejects it without candidate control)
runner and shared libraries root-copy sealed read-only before sampling; entire candidate-owned build tree deleted (no candidate-owned executable or re-chmod-able file is ever timed)
peak RSS from kernel wait4 rusage of the reaped runner child; never transits a candidate-writable file
fresh writable state per rep: per-rep working dir plus pre-sample sweep of /tmp and /dev/shm and kill/reap of any surviving demoted process (pid-1 orphan reaping included)
fresh IPC and NET namespaces unshared in the demoted preexec for every candidate process
sealed assets hash-verified, copied read-only, unmounted before candidate build; oracle retained only in the trusted parent; exact typed-output validation per sample
evaluator runs under broker eval-container capabilities (no CAP_CHOWN); verified through the real broker eval path, not only out-of-band containers

controls.role: deliberately slower but correct per-chunk volatile work
independently authored split-agnostic filter bypass for the always-true case-function predicate
train-only bypass with bounded validation-only diagnostic delay — split inversion control

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.estimator: min-of-N ref/target reference-yardstick (score = NORM_CONST[1.0] * min(reference)/min(target) over 7 timed fresh-process target/reference pairs, 2 warmups; the filter-free reference query never invokes the mutable PhysicalFilter, so it is candidate-independent and its per-binary minimum cancels shared-host contention drift)
